quest.title: Proof of Guilt
quest.description: You hurry to find proof of your claims to Kujou Sara that the Kujou Clan has betrayed the Shogunate within three days.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Primogem x30, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Find the helper who Yae Miko spoke of

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! That toy tanuki just turned into a human!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? Paimon's never seen one of these before!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Not a tanuki... I'm a mujina... *snore*...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I'm so tired... If I don't get enough sleep... it'll stunt my growth...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, is this the "professional" you were talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh... She doesn't look very professional at all.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehe... She is a member of the Shuumatsuban, a genuine, bona-fide ninja.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, a ninja! So was that one of those legendary ninja transformation techniques?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, what's the Shuumatsuban?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It belongs to the Yashiro Commission. A secret unit under Kamisato Ayato.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Now, Kamisato Ayato and the Yashiro Commission are neutral parties, so I have no right to give orders to the Shuumatsuban.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: However, convincing their most chronically lazy member to help us is well within my abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Here's what I need you to do: Go into town and find evidence of the Tenryou Commission's betrayal.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It would not be appropriate for me to be seen there myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You make it sound so simple, but...

choices.text: I have no idea what I'm looking for.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hmm? Oh, I thought you would have figured it out by now. Alright then, I'll indulge you with a little more information.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: For a complete outsider, probing the inner workings of the Tenryou Commission is nigh on impossible.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: But since the three Commissions work together to serve the Shogun, they have a close relationship. Someone from one of the other Commissions might have an easier job of figuring out what they're up to...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Yashiro Commission!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hehe... Now you're following me.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The Shogun's Army haven't given up on their search for you yet, but with the help of this Shuumatsuban ninja, I'm sure you'll be able to rendezvous with your friends.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Don't forget we're on a tight schedule here. Be sure to bring back the evidence in good time.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Did you meet with the resistance? How's the battle going? Is it safe for me to come out yet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not just yet... We saw people patrolling on our way here.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: So it's still not over... I guess you came here because you have something to discuss?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'll get someone to call for Miss Kamisato, bear with me for one second.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen Text
dialogues.text: You inform Ayaka and Thoma of the current situation...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I see. You have been through a lot since we last met.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I understand, you need evidence of the Tenryou Commission's betrayal. Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, there is one thing that has always concerned me. The Shogun's Army has been at war with the resistance for a long time now, but not once has the Shogun ever inquired about it.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I used to think that she simply didn't care, but looking at it now, perhaps the problem all along has been with the <color=#00E1FFFF>Tenryou Commission's reports</color> to the Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission presides over domestic military affairs. If they ever had any intention of concealing information in their reports, we would have no way of knowing.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, the Shogun would incorrectly conclude that the Vision Hunt Decree poses no threat, and would stick to her decision. If we had access to their reports, it would confirm everything.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: But as I recall, the only person authorized to access that kind of official documentation is Kujou Takayuki.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: It's heavily guarded too. Even with Sayu's help, swiping a document from under their noses is no easy task.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: If only there was a way we could distract the guards just for long enough.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Yoimiya's fireworks!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: That's a very Thoma-sounding suggestion...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: But it's a reasonable one. The Statue of the Omnipresent God is right by the Tenryou Commission. If someone set off fireworks near the statue, they certainly wouldn't ignore it.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: While they were preoccupied with that, Sayu could infiltrate the Tenryou Commission and take the report, as well as any other evidence she might find...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Great! It feels like I'm getting closer and closer to being a free man again.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Ah... It feels like it's been an eternity since we last sat down and talked like this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's not been quite that long...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Well, it certainly felt like it to me... I've been looking forward to seeing you again every day since I got here!

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: This teahouse used to be my favorite hiding place, but now... I've honestly lost track of how long it's been since I last set foot outside of here.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Oh, man! I want to go to the hot springs so badly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Poor Thoma...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Let's focus on the issue at hand. The sooner the Vision Hunt Decree is abolished, the sooner Thoma will be free.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: This was a reunion of sorts, but there's no time to catch up. We'll celebrate properly when it's all over.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Oh, let's play the hot pot game again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're still thinking about that!?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: The Tenryou Commission is heavily guarded. Be careful when you get near. Let's meet back here afterwards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}. First, let's go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Hanamizaka</color> to find <color=#00E1FFFF>Yoimiya</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, we need an extra-large firework! The super, duper big kind!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: "Extra-large firework"?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, you sure came to the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: As it happens, I made this really souped-up one just a couple days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But it's so powerful that I haven't found anywhere I can test it out yet... may as well give it to you. Let me know how it turns out.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Don't forget, move well away from it after you light the fuse, and try to avoid burning your clothes. Also, it's best that you cover your ears...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, why does Paimon feel so nervous all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, don't worry, it's just a firework, come on. What's the worst that could happen!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll give it a try... Thanks, Yoimiya.

talks.objective: Go to the designated location near the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Hmm... Pretty much how I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: There are loads and loads of people... If one of them spots me, I'll get caught...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: We need to get rid of them, or I won't be able to sneak inside...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll just have to trust Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: After I get the document, let's meet back at <color=#00E1FFFF>Komore Teahouse</color>, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Also, if I do get caught... please come rescue me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this really a good idea...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, a—anyway, let's make our way to the <color=#00E1FFFF>statue</color>! Careful does it, watch out for guards and don't get caught!

talks.objective: Set off fireworks to distract the guards
Set off fireworks to distract the guards
Flee the scene and return to Komore Teahouse

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}? How did it go?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Well done. Let's wait for news from Sayu.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After some time...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: *panting*...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I know exercise helps you grow, but this was a little too much exercise...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I feel so dizzy... Everyone is spinning...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: No, I can't sleep yet. There was something important I was supposed to do first... Oh, right, yeah. I got it!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I didn't know how to find the document you guys were talking about, so I just swiped a whole bunch of stuff that looked suspicious.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Here you go... I'm going to sleep now...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Milady, what are we looking at?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: This sealed envelope must be an official report that the Tenryou Commission is preparing to present to the Shogun.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: In addition, we have... correspondence with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: It seems that Guuji Yae was right. They have been fomenting unrest behind the scenes.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, this should be ample evidence. Please take them to <color=#00E1FFFF>Guuji Yae</color>. I trust she will have a plan for the next step.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I will also gather some people to try and root out the rest of the Fatui in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Still, mind yourself when you face the Shogun. I still get goosebumps just thinking about her drawing that blade...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Again, we'll just have to trust Guuji Yae. She is close to the Shogun, so maybe she will have a way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon remembers correctly, it should be time for our meeting with Yae Miko soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's pack up our things and get ready to head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Grand Narukami Shrine</color>.

choices.text: We lit the firework and ran away...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: *sigh* I really hope the plan works out...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is there anything else you want?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Fireworks are more visible at night... If possible, I suggest you wait till <color=#00E1FFFF>after dark</color> to put your plan into action.

dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: Stop! I have orders to search for a wanted criminal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! Hide — quick!

dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: You! The warrant is for your arrest! Freeze!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no — run!
